title: Californians' data deletion requests, DROP, become enforceable Aug. 1
excerpt: California residents can use the DROP system to request registered data brokers stop selling their personal information.
content_html:
If you've ever wondered how much of your personal information is collected every time you go online, California is giving consumers a new way to push back.

Starting Aug. 1, registered California data brokers must begin honoring requests submitted through the state's Delete Request Opt-out Platform, better known as DROP.

The online tool allows California residents to ask registered data brokers to stop selling their personal information without having to contact hundreds of companies individually.

Since Jan. 1, about 350,000 Californians have already signed up through the DROP website.

Every time someone shops online, streams entertainment, or simply browses the internet, pieces of that person's digital footprint can be collected, packaged and sold.

"In the digital economy, our personal information is basically oil," Tom Kemp with Cal Privacy said.

NBC 7 Responds

Kemp said many consumers don't realize just how much information is collected whenever they go online.

"We oftentimes are the product, our information, our data is the product that people collect, package up into digital dossiers and sell," Kemp said.

He said that information has long been used for targeted advertising.

"Historically, that's been used for targeted advertising. So if you go shopping for red shoes, the red shoes follow you around for the next three weeks," Kemp said.

But Kemp said the information can also become valuable to criminals.

"The bad guys, the hackers are leveraging the data from data brokers," Kemp said.

Instead of contacting roughly 600 registered data brokers one by one, Californians can submit a single request through the DROP website.

"We're all gonna hear a giant sucking sound outside of our data being deleted from all these data brokers systems," Kemp said.

He said doing the process manually would be overwhelming.

"The alternative is you would have to contact 600 companies and say, please delete my information. And who's got time for that?" Kemp said.

Beginning Aug. 1, registered data brokers have 45 days to process requests submitted through the system. That 45-day processing period repeats for new requests.

Companies that fail to comply can face fines of $200 per day for each affected Californian.

"And my agency has a dedicated team that will go after to make sure that the will of Californians to take control of their information is taken care of," a Cal Privacy representative said.

Cal Privacy told NBC 7 Responds it has already fined 12 data brokers tens of thousands of dollars each for failing to register in the DROP system.

The agency said only California residents are eligible to use DROP, and the tool will not erase all personal information that exists online. Consumers should continue watching for scams and take other steps to protect their personal information.

More information about the Delete Request Opt-out Platform is available at https://privacy.ca.gov/drop/.

This story was originally reported for broadcast by NBC San Diego. AI tools helped convert the story to a digital article, and an NBC San Diego journalist edited the article for publication.

content_html_zh:
如果您想知道每次上网时您的个人信息会被收集多少，加州正在为消费者提供一种新的反击方式。

从 8 月 1 日开始，注册的加州数据经纪人必须开始尊重通过该州的删除请求选择退出平台（俗称 DROP）提交的请求。

该在线工具允许加州居民要求注册数据经纪人停止出售他们的个人信息，而无需单独联系数百家公司。

自 1 月 1 日以来，已有约 35 万加州人通过 DROP 网站注册。

每当有人在线购物、流媒体娱乐或只是浏览互联网时，该人的数字足迹片段就可以被收集、打包和出售。

“在数字经济中，我们的个人信息基本上就是石油，”加州隐私公司的汤姆·坎普说。

NBC 7 回应

坎普说，许多消费者并没有意识到，每当他们上网时，他们会收集多少信息。

“我们常常是产品，我们的信息，我们的数据是人们收集、打包成数字档案并出售的产品，”坎普说。

他说，信息长期以来一直被用于有针对性的广告。

“从历史上看，这曾被用于有针对性的广告。 因此，如果你去购买红色鞋子，那么红色鞋子会在接下来的三周内跟随你，”坎普说。

但坎普表示，这些信息对犯罪分子来说也很有价值。

“坏人，黑客正在利用数据经纪人的数据，”坎普说。

加州人无需一一联系大约 600 个注册数据经纪人，而是可以通过 DROP 网站提交单个请求。

坎普说：“当我们的数据从所有这些数据代理系统中删除时，我们都会听到巨大的吸吮声。”

他说，手动完成这个过程将是难以承受的。

“另一种选择是你必须联系 600 家公司并说，请删除我的信息。 谁有时间这么做？” 坎普说。

从 8 月 1 日开始，注册数据经纪人有 45 天的时间来处理通过系统提交的请求。 对于新请求，该 45 天的处理期会重复。

不遵守规定的公司可能会面临每名受影响的加州人每天 200 美元的罚款。

加州隐私代表表示：“我的机构有一个专门的团队，将确保加州人控制其信息的意愿得到照顾。”

Cal Privacy 告诉 NBC 7 Responds，它已经对 12 家数据经纪人处以数万美元的罚款，因为他们未能在 DROP 系统中注册。

该机构表示，只有加州居民才有资格使用 DROP，并且该工具不会删除网上存在的所有个人信息。 消费者应继续警惕诈骗，并采取其他措施来保护他们的个人信息。

有关删除请求选择退出平台的更多信息，请访问 https://privacy.ca.gov/drop/。
